# Policy Template

```yaml
id: POL-XXX
title: <policy title>
type: policy
version: 1.0
status: draft
owner: <role>
created: YYYY-MM-DD
updated: YYYY-MM-DD
review_frequency: annual
depends_on: [IEOS-FP-001]
implements: []
related_documents: []
supersedes: []
tags: [policy, <domain>]
```

## Purpose

What does this policy govern?

## Scope

Who and what does this policy apply to?

## Policy Statements

1. <policy statement>
2. <policy statement>

## Enforcement

How is this policy enforced?

## Violations

What happens when this policy is violated?

## Governance References

- First Principles: <which principles>
- Constitution: <which articles>
